apps.message:
fix: the listing comment of a re-run shows the re-run's result

## Intent

A re-run of the listing check keeps the run's id and adds a second report. The comment took the first one, so after a passing re-run it still showed the old failure (apps#68). A reviewer must see the latest result.

## Key changes

- The comment workflow picks the newest report of the run and links that one as the full report.
- The plan records what the first update showed: the update pull request opened while the creator's deploy was still running, so the first check saw the old app.

## Dependencies and side effects

- apps ea038f5 fixes where the downloaded report lands.

apps.message:
fix: the listing comment finds the report it downloaded by id

## Intent

After the previous fix, the comment found no report and said the check did not finish. A report downloaded by id lands in a subfolder named after it, unless the download merges it into the target folder.

## Key changes

- The download puts the report straight into the folder the comment reads.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Completes apps d26d743.
